# jenkins_nodes (Data Source)

Lists the names of all agent nodes known to Jenkins (including the built-in node).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jenkins_nodes" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `nodes` (Set of String) The names of all nodes known to Jenkins.
